purpose: Deterministic deformation acceptance criteria for ORIGINAL v1 candidate review. These gates do not replace human anatomy review or runtime exercise validation.
provenance_rule: Historical V-series/V15f material may inform failure cases and acceptance criteria only. Do not copy geometry, coordinates, weights, bind data, materials, textures or implementation data from legacy/reference assets.

report_semantics.pose_reports: Blender candidate stress poses exercise deformation ranges; they are not the runtime exercise solver and do not by themselves prove exercise biomechanics.
report_semantics.self_intersections: Production target is zero unexplained body self-intersections. Legitimate surface contact must be classified explicitly rather than hidden by threshold changes.
report_semantics.edge_ratios: Ratios compare posed edge length with rest edge length. Extreme local values indicate collapse/stretch and are used as deformation diagnostics, not anatomy measurements.

development_blocker.description: Coarse gate for deciding whether a candidate is too deformed to spend time on cosmetic polish or production promotion.

production_target.description: Target gate before the character can be considered for production promotion. Owner/anatomy review and runtime movement/contact gates still remain mandatory.

repair_priority.reason: Own every current shoulder/upper-torso blocker across press, arm-elevation, squat arm position and pull-up/bar loading before cosmetic work.
Own current hand/finger/thumb/arm and equipment-contact blockers across all major gripping orientations, not only curl close-ups.
Deep-flexion tests expose groin/hip/torso collapse and stretch that must be resolved before final shorts or materials.
Floor-loaded wrist/hand and arm deformation still shows local collapse and self-intersection.
Row deformation is secondary to overhead, grip and deep-flexion blockers but must pass before broad exercise-family promotion.

historical_lessons_allowed: V8 knee geometry was the accepted historical knee visual baseline.
V9-V14 hand experiments exposed palm, fingertip, thumb and grip failure modes that should become tests rather than copied geometry.
The accepted shoulder/clavicle skeleton correction showed that later forward-shoulder visual defects were mesh/skin problems, so ORIGINAL v1 must prove shoulder deformation under elevation.
V15f is reference-only and may inform visual failure cases and quality expectations, never production implementation data.

comparison_tolerances.description: Maximum numerical drift permitted before a candidate is classified as a severity regression. These are noise/iteration tolerances, not relaxed acceptance limits.
